how_to_use.title: How to make a Spicy Mango
how_to_use.description: Simply pour 15ml BarCraft mixer, add 45ml of tequila, vodka (neutral) or mango flavoured vodka, add 15ml chilled water or soda with ice, and serve over fresh ice in a chilli-salt-rimmed glass.
steps: Rim a rocks glass with chilli salt and fill it with fresh ice.
Pour in 45ml of tequila, neutral vodka or mango flavoured vodka.
Add 15ml of BarCraft Spicy Mango Mixer.
Add 15ml of chilled water or soda.
how_to_use.mocktail_note: For a mocktail, leave out the spirit. Precision in every pour. Pleasure in every sip.

items.question: What is BarCraft Spicy Mango Mixer?
items.answer: BarCraft Spicy Mango Mixer is a BarCraft Crafted Cocktail Mixer made to bring the character of a well-crafted cocktail to every pour. It is bartender inspired, with the flavour profile Sweet Tropical Heat: Juicy ripe mango, zesty lime and warming chilli, finishing with a subtle salty tang.

items.question: What does Spicy Mango mixer taste like?
items.answer: Sweet Tropical Heat. Juicy ripe mango, zesty lime and warming chilli, finishing with a subtle salty tang.

items.question: How do I make a Spicy Mango with BarCraft Mixer?
items.answer: Simply pour 15ml BarCraft mixer, add 45ml of tequila, vodka (neutral) or mango flavoured vodka, add 15ml chilled water or soda with ice, and serve over fresh ice in a chilli-salt-rimmed glass.

items.question: Which spirit should I use?
items.answer: The label suggests tequila, vodka (neutral) or mango flavoured vodka. The mixer does not include a spirit, so add your own.

items.question: How many drinks does a bottle make?
items.answer: One serving is 15ml, so the 600ml bottle makes about 40 servings and the 60ml bottle makes 4.

items.question: Can I make Spicy Mango as a mocktail?
items.answer: Yes. Leave out the spirit and use ice, 15ml of BarCraft Spicy Mango Mixer and chilled soda.

items.question: What are the ingredients?
items.answer: Water, Sugar, Glycerol [Humectant (INS 422)], Lime Juice Concentrate, Acidity Regulators [Citric Acid (INS 330), Sodium Citrate (INS 331)], Mint Extract, Natural and Nature-Identical Flavouring Substances, Sweetener [Sucralose (INS 955)], Common Salt, Preservatives [Potassium Sorbate (INS 202), Sodium Benzoate (INS 211)], Permitted Natural Colour.

items.question: How much sugar and how many calories does it have?
items.answer: Approximate values per 100ml are 160 kcal and 28g total sugars (all added). For one 15ml serve of the mixer that works out to about 24 kcal and 4.2g sugars, before any spirit or soda.

items.question: Does it contain preservatives or sweeteners?
items.answer: Yes. According to the label it contains the preservatives Potassium Sorbate (INS 202) and Sodium Benzoate (INS 211), and the sweetener Sucralose (INS 955).

items.question: Which bottle size should I buy?
items.answer: Choose the 600ml bottle for home bars, parties and regular use. Choose the 60ml bottle to try the flavour, to travel or to gift.
